import os
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import torchvision.models as models
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", index_col=0)
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", index_col=0)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}, Test samples: {len(test_df)}")


# Create dataset class
class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, root_dir="input/images", size=224):
        self.df = df
        self.root_dir = root_dir
        self.size = size
        self.transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(size),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        image_id = self.df.iloc[idx]["image_id"]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.root_dir, f"{image_id}.jpg")
        image = self.transform(torchvision.io.imread(img_path))
        targets = self.df.iloc[idx]
        return {"image": image, "id": image_id, "targets": targets}, {
            "image_id": image_id
        }


# Define dataset loader
train_dataset = LeafDataset(train_df, size=224)
test_dataset = LeafDataset(test_df, size=224)
train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False)

# Prepare target mappings
target_cols = ["healthy", "rust", "scab", "multiple_diseases"]
y_train = {}
for col in target_cols:
    y_train[col] = train_df[col].values

# Build model with Transfer Learning
model = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
feature_dim = model.fc.in_features
model.fc = torch.nn.Linear(feature_dim, 4)
model = model.to(device)

criterion = torch.nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(optimizer, step_size=10, gamma=0.5)

# Training loop
num_epochs = 20
model.train()
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    running_loss = 0
    correct_predictions = []
    all_preds = []
    for batch_idx, (inputs, outputs) in enumerate(val_loader):
        images = inputs["image"].to(device)
        ids = inputs["id"]
        outputs = outputs.to(device)

        # Forward pass
        preds = model(images)
        loss = criterion(preds, torch.from_numpy(np.array(outputs)))

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        running_loss += loss.item()
        all_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu())

    # Compute metrics on validation set
    val_scores = {}
    for col in target_cols:
        scores = torch.sigmoid(all_preds[-1][col]).numpy().flatten()
        val_scores[col] = roc_auc_score(train_df[col].values, scores)

    mean_auc = np.mean(list(val_scores.values()))
    scheduler.step()
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs}, Loss: {running_loss:.4f}, Mean AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}"
    )

# Evaluation on test set
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    all_test_preds = []
    for batch_idx, (inputs, outputs) in enumerate(val_loader):
        images = inputs["image"].to(device)
        ids = outputs["image_id"]
        outputs = outputs.to(device)

        preds = model(images)
        all_test_preds.append(preds.detach().cpu())

    test_preds = all_test_preds[-1]
    test_ids = test_df.index.tolist()

    # Prepare submission
    submission_data = []
    for i, id_ in enumerate(test_ids):
        row = {"image_id": id_}
        for col in target_cols:
            prob = torch.sigmoid(test_preds[i][col]).item()
            row[f"{col}_"] = round(prob, 4)
        submission_data.append(row)

    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
    submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved successfully!")

# Final Evaluation Metric
all_probabilities = [
    test_preds[i][col].item() for col in target_cols for i in range(len(test_df))
]
final_auc = (
    roc_auc_score(train_df["healthy"], all_probabilities[0::4])
    + roc_auc_score(train_df["rust"], all_probabilities[1::4])
    + roc_auc_score(train_df["scab"], all_probabilities[2::4])
    + roc_auc_score(train_df["multiple_diseases"], all_probabilities[3::4])
)
mean_metric = final_auc / 4
print(f"Final mean-column-wise-ROC-AUC: {mean_metric:.4f}")
